📦 Master Database File

  • Sole Master Database: output/GoRefs_Master.duckdb
  • Normalized Domain Tables: species, forms, moves, progression, type_effectiveness, weather_boosts, community_days, raid_bosses, max_battles, quests, regional_species, nesting_species, baby_species, shadow_species, mega_species, badges, pvp_leagues, discrepancies, change_history

💻 Developer Query Examples

Query master database directly using Python & DuckDB:

import duckdb

con = duckdb.connect('output/GoRefs_Master.duckdb')
species_df = con.execute("SELECT name, dex_number, gen FROM species WHERE can_mega_evolve = true").df()
print(species_df)

⚙️ Streamlined Pipeline Execution

# 1. Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/your-username/GoRefs.git && cd GoRefs

# 2. Fetch raw snapshots from all 7 sources
uv run go_refs.py --fetch

# 3. Build master dataset into output/GoRefs_Master.duckdb
uv run go_refs.py --build

# 4. Start local web server & WASM console
uv run go_refs.py --serve
